## About
APV Auto Repairs is a family owned shop in Conroe, run by Tom and Vi Pham. They live in The Woodlands and started the shop to offer something their community needed: honest, quality auto repair.
Most of our customers find us through word of mouth from friends and family. People come from Conroe, The Woodlands, Spring, Porter, Kingwood, Humble, Cleveland and farther to have their cars looked after here.
Our promise is simple. You get a truthful diagnosis, fair and honest pricing, and courteous service, whether it is an oil change or a transmission rebuild.

## Services
- Transmission rebuilds and overhauls: Transmission rebuilds and complete overhauls.
- Computer diagnostics: OBDII computer diagnostics to find out what is really going on with your vehicle.
- Brake systems: Brake inspection and repair.
- A/C and heating service: Keeping your cabin cool in the summer and warm when it turns cold.
- Engine tune-up and repair: From routine tune-ups to engine repair.
- Struts and shocks: Struts and shocks for a steadier ride.
- Power windows and locks: Repairs for power windows and locks.
- Oil change: Routine oil changes to keep your engine running right.
- Tire rotations: Regular tire rotations to help your tires wear evenly.
- Coolants, belts and hoses: Coolant service and replacement of worn belts and hoses.

## FAQ
Q: Do you offer a shuttle while my car is in the shop?
A: Yes. We provide a free local shuttle service for your convenience.

Q: Is your work covered by a warranty?
A: Yes. All work is backed by our One Year / 12,000 mile warranty.
